name: Calagopus
description: Modern game server management panel built in Rust. Deploy, monitor, and manage Minecraft, Hytale, and other game servers with industry-leading performance.

notes.text: Installs the All-in-One (AIO) build, which bundles the Panel and Wings in a single binary for single-node deployments.
Docker is installed as a system dependency because Wings uses it to run the actual game server containers; the Panel and Wings processes themselves run natively, not inside Docker.
The encryption key is generated automatically and saved to /etc/calagopus/.env. Back it up, losing it will make existing data unreadable.
